observations: The page number «65» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «9» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L01-L11 end chapter 19 (p. 64, JP2 0096, L34-L38). L12-L13: the heading of chapters 20 and 21, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L01-L11. Checked: the daily and hourly motions of the moon's node are those of chapter 19 of the Latin text (p. 15, JP2 0047, L13-L15); 7″ 57‴ × 24 = 3′ 10″ 48‴; 360° in 6798.3355 days are 3′ 10″ 38‴ a day. L03-L04: «so muss es also heissen statt 3′ 11″ 48‴» leaves the value 3′ 10″ 48‴ of the clause before it to be understood. The comparison with al-Battānī's tables (note 1) is not checked here.

L17-L23. Checked: the daily and hourly motions of the moon and the sun of chapters 20 and 21 of the Latin text (p. 15, JP2 0047, L17-L20 and L22-L24); 13° 10′ 34″ 52‴ 48⁗ : 24 = 32′ 56″ 27‴ 12⁗; 59′ 8″ : 24 = 2′ 27″ 50‴, and 59′ 8″ 10‴ : 24 = 2′ 27″ 50‴ 25⁗.

L24-L38. Checked: 24 × 2′ 27″ 50‴ 25⁗ = 59′ 8″ 10‴; 365 × 59′ 8″ 10‴ = 359° 44′ 40″ 50‴; the remaining 15′ 19″ 10‴ need 0.25905 days, so that the year is 365.25905 days, 365d 6h 13m 2s. The Sūrya-Siddhānta's year, 1 577 917 828 days in 4 320 000 years, is 365d 6h 12m 36.6s, 25.5s less; Brahmagupta's, 1 577 916 450 000 days in 4 320 000 000 years, 365d 6h 12m 9s, 53s less. The daily motions are 59′ 8″ 10‴ 10⁗ 24^V and 59′ 8″ 10‴ 21⁗ 33^V, the hourly 2′ 27″ 50‴ 25⁗ 26^V (25,4⁗) and 2′ 27″ 50‴ 25⁗ 53^V (25,9⁗); the text's 21⁗ 22^V (L35) is 11 fifths short of the second daily motion, and its 25,8⁗ (L37) is the hourly motion truncated, where 25,4⁗ (L36) is truncated too. L27: «(p. 42)», the year of 365d 6h 13m (p. 42, JP2 0074, L08-L13).

L18-L19, L21, L25, L34-L38: the fourths written with a raised italic IV, the fifths of L35 with a raised italic V; L08: «6798d,3355», the d raised between the whole days and the decimals; L27, L30-L31, L33-L35: the d, h, m and s raised. L31: «Ārya-Siddhānta,», with the macron over the capital A.

L26: a speck on the base line before «mittlern»; not transcribed. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Kh.», «Nallino»; italics: «Siddhāntas», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Ārya-Siddhānta,», «Brahma-Siddhānta».
The semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (13-16 px measured).
